operations.name: Bryce Michael Williams

expected.name: Bryce Michael Williams
expected.description: Bryce Michael Williams was federally prosecuted for helping carry a Molotov cocktail into the Minneapolis Police Department’s Third Precinct during the May 28, 2020 protests following George Floyd’s murder. Police arrested him on June 16, 2020. Williams pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit arson on November 19, 2020. On June 7, 2021, a federal judge sentenced him to 27 months in prison, two years of supervised release, and $12 million in joint restitution.
